subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the Option B local-date prefix as the reset/delete archive filename contract, and require QMD/memory/archive consumers to support it before merge?
rationale: This changes persisted session artifact names and uses an existing timezone setting for a new file-discovery surface, so the code fix needs maintainer confirmation of the contract as well as compatibility coverage.

options.title: Approve Option B with full coverage
options.body: Require the PR to update QMD/memory/archive readers and post real reset/delete proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the filename contract
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open until maintainers choose a different persisted filename or metadata strategy.

options.title: Accept the narrower basename change
options.body: Merge only the reset/delete basename prefix and knowingly defer QMD archive-hit resolution as follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Approve Option B with full coverage
recommendation.body: Require the PR to update QMD/memory/archive readers and post real reset/delete proof before merge.
